title: The Technocratic assault on Horizon
summary: A strike at the Traditions’ home Realm.

claims.text: Technocratic forces attacked Horizon itself, using Prime Drainers aboard a combat dreadnought to strike at the Realm’s foundations while the defenders’ eyes were on the city of Concordia.
Marianna of Balador, the Ecstatic Tradition’s voice among the Nine, was a close friend of the archmage Kallikos.
